article.linkText: No. 11 Tennessee hosts Tennessee State following Bradshaw's 23-point showing
article.story: Tennessee State Tigers (2-1) at Tennessee Volunteers (2-0) Knoxville, Tennessee; Friday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Volunteers -29.5; over/under is 156.5 BOTTOM LINE: Tennessee State takes on No. 11 Tennessee after Aaron Bradshaw scored 23 points in Tennessee State's 123-73 victory over the Fisk Bulldogs. Tennessee went 14-3 at home last season while going 25-12 overall. The Volunteers gave up 69.6 points per game while committing 18.1 fouls last season. Tennessee State went 23-10 overall a season ago while going 9-7 on the road. The Tigers averaged 9.3 steals, 3.8 blocks and 11.7 turnovers per game last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
